summary: First test run. Backend contact API (POST/GET/DELETE + validation + admin auth) all pass (11/11). Frontend verified end-to-end: fluid-canvas renders (WebGL), nav links scroll via lenis, hero CTAs scroll, project cards (zerohour/recoilbot/stealthgpt) render with correct links (roblox + github.com/VirtualBlack2), resume reveal and repaint toggles work, resume PDF download link returns 200 PDF, contact form submits successfully (toast + fields clear) and invalid emails blocked by native validation. /inbox page: wrong key shows inbox-error, correct admin key lists messages, delete button removes message. Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow, layout readable. No console errors on home page.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py @app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; prefer lifespan context manager.
ContactMessage.created_at is stored as ISO string; consider datetime type for easier querying/sorting.
No rate limiting on POST /api/contact — abusable by bots since there is no captcha; consider basic throttling.
DELETE returns 404 for invalid ObjectId format which is fine, but POST does not strip HTML/sanitize input (defense-in-depth).
updated_files: /app/memory/test_credentials.md (not modified; admin key already present in /app/backend/.env; confirmed via tests)
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_-prefixed contact messages and cleaned them up via DELETE /api/contact/{id} within pytest and Playwright flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All feature scenarios in the review request passed. backend_test lives at /app/backend/tests/test_contact_api.py and is idempotent (seeds TEST_ data, deletes it). Admin key is required for GET/DELETE /api/contact. /inbox route works at /inbox on the public URL.
